API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITraffic ForwardingGRE Tunnel Resource Update GRE Tunnel
GRE Tunnel Resource Update GRE Tunnel
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/greTunnels/:Id

Updates the GRE tunnel information for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
Id
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the GRE tunnel.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED

GRE tunnel information.

sourceIp
string

The source IP address of the GRE tunnel. This is typically a static IP address in the organization or SD-WAN. This IP address must be provisioned within the Zscaler service using the /staticIP endpoint.

primaryDestVip
object
secondaryDestVip
object
internalIpRange
string

The start of the internal IP address in /29 CIDR range

lastModificationTime
int32

When the GRE tunnel information was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
withinCountry
boolean

Restrict the data center virtual IP addresses (VIPs) only to those within the same country as the source IP address

comment
string

Additional information about this GRE tunnel

ipUnnumbered
boolean

This is required to support the automated SD-WAN provisioning of GRE tunnels, when set to true gre_tun_ip and gre_tun_id are set to null

subcloud
string

Restrict the data center virtual IP addresses (VIPs) only to those part of the subcloud

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Unique identifier of the static IP address that is associated to a GRE tunnel

sourceIp
string

The source IP address of the GRE tunnel. This is typically a static IP address in the organization or SD-WAN. This IP address must be provisioned within the Zscaler service using the /staticIP endpoint.

object
secondaryDestVip
object
internalIpRange
string

The start of the internal IP address in /29 CIDR range

managedBy
object

int32

When the GRE tunnel information was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
withinCountry
boolean

Restrict the data center virtual IP addresses (VIPs) only to those within the same country as the source IP address

comment
string

Additional information about this GRE tunnel

ipUnnumbered
boolean

This is required to support the automated SD-WAN provisioning of GRE tunnels, when set to true gre_tun_ip and gre_tun_id are set to null

subcloud
string

Restrict the data center virtual IP addresses (VIPs) only to those part of the subcloud
